about.body:
OneWay Media is a company serving Cairo, Giza, Nasr City, New Cairo, the New Administrative Capital and all of Egypt, working in **live streaming**, **video production** and **photography**.

We film and stream conferences, sports tournaments, medical reels and corporate events, and we cover reel creators at important events, and our goal is for your work to come out in quality you can be proud of.

## What do we do?

- **Live streaming** for your conferences, sports tournaments and corporate events on YouTube, Facebook and Instagram.
- **Video production** for conferences, medical reels, corporate events and ads, from the idea to the final edit.
- **Photography** for conferences, tournaments, events, portraits and products.

privacy.title: Privacy Policy
privacy.description: Privacy Policy of the OneWay Media website: what data we collect and how we use it.
privacy.body:
Last updated: 26 November 2026

This page explains how the OneWay Media website handles your data when you visit the site or contact us.

## Data we collect

The website has no sign-up forms or user accounts, and we do not ask you to enter your data on the site. The site does not currently use visitor analytics or advertising tools.

## Contacting us

When you press the WhatsApp button you are taken to the WhatsApp app. Messages you send are covered by WhatsApp's privacy policy, and we use your number and what you write only to answer your request and arrange the service.

## Embedded videos

Some pages show YouTube videos. The YouTube player is only loaded when you press the video, and YouTube may then store cookies according to its own policy.

## Hosting

The website is hosted on Cloudflare, whose servers may record standard technical data such as IP address and browser type for security and performance.

## External links

The website contains links to other sites such as Instagram, Facebook, YouTube and Google Maps. We are not responsible for the privacy policies of those sites.

## Data sharing

We do not sell your data and do not share it with anyone unless required by law.

## Questions about privacy

For any question about this policy, contact us on WhatsApp or at the email address shown on the Contact us page.
